As a postgraduate in UCL’s English Department you can expect:
*   To work with specialists in a wide range of fields.  
*   A lively, engaged, and welcoming community of staff and students.  
*   A full programme of research seminars, invited speakers, and papers given by graduate students, alongside research methods and career development workshops.  
*   Access to an incomparable range of archives and libraries, including the Senate House Library and the British Library, both of which are nearby.

# English Education MA
## The foundation of your career
### Networking
The course includes a diverse cohort of students with experience of teaching English as a subject in the UK and internationally. English teaching includes literature, media and drama as well as literacy and language and students may teach across different phases of education. In addition, there are opportunities to attend some seminars in IOE as well as events for English teachers in London.

# English Education MA
## Teaching and learning
The MA is delivered through a combination of face-to-face seminars and online materials; sessions are always interactive, drawing on students' own interests and experiences.
Most modules are assessed by means of written essays, but some offer alternative forms of assessment e.g., a presentation or creative writing, drama, a film, animation or game.
For full-time students, typical contact hours are around 6 - 8 hours per week in terms 1 and 2. Teaching is a mixture of lectures, seminars, workshops, tutorials, feedback, and the use of a Virtual Learning Environment. In addition to this, full-time students typically study a minimum 7 hours per week, per module, in self-directed study, plus, students would be required to commit additional time to preparing and completing coursework assignments.
In term 3, students will be completing their drafts and then the final assignments for both of their term 2 modules, and continuing their dissertation research, keeping regular contact with their dissertation supervisors into mid July (draft submission) and then completing the research, analysis and final writing up of their dissertation during August.
Please note that contact hours may vary depending on the modules you choose.
Please note that the longitudinal module ‘Developing Understanding in English, Media, Drama Studies’ is available only to MA English Education students who are employed to teach English in a school for the duration of the module, and who are generally on the modular flexible or part-time route. International full-time students are not eligible to select this module. We recommend that full-time students enrol on one or more of the optional modules, such as ‘Creativity: from theory to practice in English, Media, Drama’; ‘Shakespeare in Education'; and Literature for Children and Young People: Theory and Text.

June 6, 2024
The Guardian University Guide 2024 league table, which ranks institutions by subject, looking at areas such as student satisfaction, has once again recognised ARU for a variety of subject areas such as Sports Science, Hospitality, Event Management and Tourism, English, and Education. ARU College offer both undergraduate and postgraduate pathways into a variety of degrees in these disciplines.

## Sports Science
ARU was ranked **10th in the UK** for Sports Science (The Guardian 2024). ARU College offerBSc Sports and Exercise Science, BSc Sports and Exercise Therapy, BSc Sports Coaching and Physical Education, and BSc (Hons)Strength and Conditioning with Rehabilitationall available with a Foundation Year pathway. Students studying sport science at ARU are based in the state-of-the-art Cambridge Centre for Sports and Exercise Sciences. There is also the opportunity to complete an optional placement year.

## Hospitality, Event Management and Tourism
Ranked **7th in the UK** by The Guardian 2024.
At ARU College we offer BSc in Business with Events Management, taught on our Cambridge campus. A career in events management opens up a world of possibilities, from becoming a top events and marketing manager to an event organiser, a skilled PR executive, or even a wedding planner. The curriculum is designed to provide students with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in these dynamic fields. Again, there is also the opportunity to conduct a placement year with this degree.

## English
ARU’s English degrees have been ranked**11th in the UK**. An English degree is a popular choice and can equip students with a wide range of career options. At ARU College, we offer both BA English Literature and BA English Language and Communication with Foundation Year entry. ARU Language and Literature research was awarded ‘world-leading’ status in the Research Excellence Framework 2021. ARU English degrees are taught by a team of expert lecturers who are dedicated to their academic and professional growth. For international students, we also offer Pre-masters in MA English Literature.

## Education
ARU Education degrees have achieved a prestigious **7th place ranking in the UK**. At ARU College, we offer BA Primary Education Studies and BA Early Childhood Studies (Graduate Practitioner). Students are taught in Chelmsford, where they have access to an impressive Early Childhood Resource and Research Room filled with toys, games, and equipment, allowing students to experience the world from a child’s perspective. With placement year opportunities available, Primary Education and Childhood Studies graduates will be well-prepared to make a positive impact in the field of education. We also offer a large variety of postgraduate (pre-masters) pathways for Education degrees, including:
*   MA Education with Early Childhood  
*   MA Education  
*   MA Education with Montessori  
*   MA Education with Leadership and Management  
*   MA Education with Special Educational Needs and Disability
To find out more or discuss your options, please contact a member of the ARU College team today.

3.   ARU Shines in The Guardian University Guide 2024
June 6, 2024
The Guardian University Guide 2024 league table, which ranks institutions by subject, looking at areas such as student satisfaction, has once again recognised ARU for a variety of subject areas such as Sports Science, Hospitality, Event Management and Tourism, English, and Education. ARU College offer both undergraduate and postgraduate pathways into a variety of degrees in these disciplines.
texts.1:
## Sports Science
ARU was ranked **10th in the UK** for Sports Science (The Guardian 2024). ARU College offerBSc Sports and Exercise Science, BSc Sports and Exercise Therapy, BSc Sports Coaching and Physical Education, and BSc (Hons)Strength and Conditioning with Rehabilitationall available with a Foundation Year pathway. Students studying sport science at ARU are based in the state-of-the-art Cambridge Centre for Sports and Exercise Sciences. There is also the opportunity to complete an optional placement year.
texts.2:
## Hospitality, Event Management and Tourism
Ranked **7th in the UK** by The Guardian 2024.
At ARU College we offer BSc in Business with Events Management, taught on our Cambridge campus. A career in events management opens up a world of possibilities, from becoming a top events and marketing manager to an event organiser, a skilled PR executive, or even a wedding planner. The curriculum is designed to provide students with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in these dynamic fields. Again, there is also the opportunity to conduct a placement year with this degree.
texts.3:
## English
ARU’s English degrees have been ranked**11th in the UK**. An English degree is a popular choice and can equip students with a wide range of career options. At ARU College, we offer both BA English Literature and BA English Language and Communication with Foundation Year entry. ARU Language and Literature research was awarded ‘world-leading’ status in the Research Excellence Framework 2021. ARU English degrees are taught by a team of expert lecturers who are dedicated to their academic and professional growth. For international students, we also offer Pre-masters in MA English Literature.
texts.4:
## Education
ARU Education degrees have achieved a prestigious **7th place ranking in the UK**. At ARU College, we offer BA Primary Education Studies and BA Early Childhood Studies (Graduate Practitioner). Students are taught in Chelmsford, where they have access to an impressive Early Childhood Resource and Research Room filled with toys, games, and equipment, allowing students to experience the world from a child’s perspective. With placement year opportunities available, Primary Education and Childhood Studies graduates will be well-prepared to make a positive impact in the field of education. We also offer a large variety of postgraduate (pre-masters) pathways for Education degrees, including:
*   MA Education with Early Childhood  
*   MA Education  
*   MA Education with Montessori  
*   MA Education with Leadership and Management  
*   MA Education with Special Educational Needs and Disability
To find out more or discuss your options, please contact a member of the ARU College team today.

June 6, 2024
The Guardian University Guide 2024 league table, which ranks institutions by subject, looking at areas such as student satisfaction, has once again recognised ARU for a variety of subject areas such as Sports Science, Hospitality, Event Management and Tourism, English, and Education. ARU College offer both undergraduate and postgraduate pathways into a variety of degrees in these disciplines.

## Sports Science
ARU was ranked **10th in the UK** for Sports Science (The Guardian 2024). ARU College offerBSc Sports and Exercise Science, BSc Sports and Exercise Therapy, BSc Sports Coaching and Physical Education, and BSc (Hons)Strength and Conditioning with Rehabilitationall available with a Foundation Year pathway. Students studying sport science at ARU are based in the state-of-the-art Cambridge Centre for Sports and Exercise Sciences. There is also the opportunity to complete an optional placement year.

## Hospitality, Event Management and Tourism
Ranked **7th in the UK** by The Guardian 2024.
At ARU College we offer BSc in Business with Events Management, taught on our Cambridge campus. A career in events management opens up a world of possibilities, from becoming a top events and marketing manager to an event organiser, a skilled PR executive, or even a wedding planner. The curriculum is designed to provide students with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in these dynamic fields. Again, there is also the opportunity to conduct a placement year with this degree.

## English
ARU’s English degrees have been ranked**11th in the UK**. An English degree is a popular choice and can equip students with a wide range of career options. At ARU College, we offer both BA English Literature and BA English Language and Communication with Foundation Year entry. ARU Language and Literature research was awarded ‘world-leading’ status in the Research Excellence Framework 2021. ARU English degrees are taught by a team of expert lecturers who are dedicated to their academic and professional growth. For international students, we also offer Pre-masters in MA English Literature.

## Education
ARU Education degrees have achieved a prestigious **7th place ranking in the UK**. At ARU College, we offer BA Primary Education Studies and BA Early Childhood Studies (Graduate Practitioner). Students are taught in Chelmsford, where they have access to an impressive Early Childhood Resource and Research Room filled with toys, games, and equipment, allowing students to experience the world from a child’s perspective. With placement year opportunities available, Primary Education and Childhood Studies graduates will be well-prepared to make a positive impact in the field of education. We also offer a large variety of postgraduate (pre-masters) pathways for Education degrees, including:
*   MA Education with Early Childhood  
*   MA Education  
*   MA Education with Montessori  
*   MA Education with Leadership and Management  
*   MA Education with Special Educational Needs and Disability
To find out more or discuss your options, please contact a member of the ARU College team today.
